# Manipal Academy of Higher Education

> > Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) is a multi-disciplinary university offering undergraduate and postgraduate programs across engineering, medicine, pharmacy, architecture, design, business, and allied health sciences.

MAHE operates multiple campuses across India including flagship locations in Manipal (Karnataka) and Bengaluru, with constituent institutions like Srishti Manipal Institute of Art, Design & Technology. The university is recognized by the Government of India and offers admissions to diverse programs through centralized processes.

## Key Topics

- MAHE (Manipal Academy of Higher Education)
- Manipal University
- Srishti Manipal Institute (SMI)
- Engineering programs (BTech, MTech)
- Pharmacy programs (BPharm, MPharm)
- Architecture programs (B.Arch, M.Arch)
- Business management (MBA)
- Art and design education
- Transdisciplinary pedagogy
- Practice-based learning
- Madhav Nagar campus (Manipal, Karnataka)
- Bengaluru campus
- Undergraduate and postgraduate programs
- Hotel management (BHM)
- Allied health sciences

- [Srishti Manipal Institute of Art, Design & Technology](https://www.manipal.edu/mu/academics/institution-list/srishti-manipal.html): Srishti Manipal Institute offering art, design & tech programs in Bengaluru
